puzzles.selection: Retain all existing 2000 records and IDs; append 2000 distinct quantiles across difficulty from remaining legally validated puzzles with popularity >=75, plays >=100, rating deviation <=100. Exclude duplicate normalized solving positions (after the setup move).
puzzles.difficulty: Original source Lichess puzzle rating, without cross-platform conversion. Personal puzzle progress is a separate local training estimate on this difficulty scale; neither is a USCF rating.

openings.generation: python-chess 1.11.2 validates PGN and emits UCI moves plus canonical opening keys.
